          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"

        lastName:
          title: Last name

          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"

          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'

          title: City

          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'

          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.

          title: Postcode
          description: The owner's postcode (4 digits). Optional. When present it must
            be valid for the owner's city per the fixed region ranges (NSW 2000-2099,
            VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any
            4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string

          type: string

          format: date

              example: 1
              readOnly: true

              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.

              example: 'Franklin, George'

              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,

            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where

                first 8 upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 of the normalized
                telephone concatenated with the last name.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of
                the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number, formatted
                '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the
                registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable identifier shared by all owners that belong to the
                same household, derived deterministically as the first 12 hex
                characters of the SHA-256 of the normalized last name and postcode
                ('<normalizedLastName>|<postcode>'). Owners with the same last name and
                postcode share this identifier automatically.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true

              title: Identity key
              description: The owner's derived identity key, formatted
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email or empty>|<householdId>'. Duplicate
                detection is consolidated onto this single key - a create is rejected
                with 409 only when a new owner's whole identity key equals an existing
                owner's.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|A1B2C3D4'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:

              description: The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner
                was created, already shared the same first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:

                owners had already been created today (on the same registration date);

              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level

                when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0), capped at 3.
                Level 4 is reserved for tenure.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The owner's region, taken from the REGION segment of the

              readOnly: true

              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true

              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:

## Summary

The requirement: expose `telephoneDisplay` — the stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans (country code, space, national digits grouped in threes, e.g. `+61 412 345 678`) — while keeping `telephone` as raw E.164.

Two changes:

1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — Added a new read-only `telephoneDisplay` string property to the `Owner` schema. Since DTOs are generated by the openapi-generator plugin, this produces the `getTelephoneDisplay()`/`setTelephoneDisplay()` accessors on `OwnerDto`.

2. **`src/main/java/.../mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** — Added a `@Mapping(target = "telephoneDisplay", ...)` and a `telephoneDisplay(Owner)` default method. It:
   - Returns the stored value unchanged when it's `null` or not a `+`-prefixed all-digits E.164 string.
   - Splits off the country calling code (matching known codes `61`/`1` longest-first, consistent with the controller's `NATIONAL_NUMBER_LENGTHS`; falls back to a single-digit code otherwise).
   - Groups the remaining national digits in threes separated by spaces, yielding e.g. `+61412345678` → `+61 412 345 678`.

The raw `telephone` field is untouched (it's still normalized to E.164 in the controller's `toE164`, unchanged).

The full test suite passes, including the new `AcceptanceTest.coreFormatsTelephoneDisplay`, which posts `0412 345 678`, then asserts `telephone` = `+61412345678` and `telephoneDisplay` = `+61 412 345 678`.
